literal: The movement of those who do not have a sense of shame inside is like a wooden puppet simulating life by a string.
translation: The movements of those who have no sense of shame in their hearts are like a wooden puppet merely mimicking life by the pulling of a string.
modern: நெஞ்சில் நாண உணர்வு இல்லாதவர்களுடைய இயக்கம், மரப்பாவையை நூலினால் ஆட்டி உயிர் உள்ளதைப் போலக் காட்டி இயக்குவதைப் போன்றதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet employs a brilliant play on the word 'நாண்'. In the first line, 'நாண்' refers to the moral sense of shame or conscience. In the second line, 'நாணால்' refers to the string or cord used to manipulate a puppet. The poet explains that a person who lacks an inner sense of shame has no true human agency or dignity. Their actions and movements are entirely mechanical, resembling a lifeless wooden puppet that is made to simulate life only because someone else is pulling its strings.
